title: Cloud Storage Privacy Policy Template
metaDescription: Professional privacy policy template for cloud storage services. Covers data encryption, user rights, and compliance requirements.
description: Comprehensive privacy policy template designed specifically for cloud storage services. Addresses data encryption, user privacy rights, third-party access, and regulatory compliance to build user trust and meet legal requirements.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect the following types of information when you use {{SERVICE_NAME}}:

• Account Information: Email address, name, and billing details for account creation and management
• File Data: Documents, images, and files you choose to store in our service
• Usage Data: Information about how you access and use our service, including IP addresses and device information
• Technical Data: File metadata, sync logs, and performance metrics to improve service quality

We only collect information necessary to provide secure cloud storage services and do not access your file contents unless explicitly authorized by you or required by law.

sections.heading: Data Security and Encryption
sections.content:
{{SERVICE_NAME}} implements industry-standard security measures to protect your data:

• End-to-End Encryption: All files are encrypted using {{ENCRYPTION_STANDARD}} before upload
• Zero-Knowledge Architecture: We cannot access your encrypted files without your password
• Secure Transmission: All data transfers use TLS encryption
• Regular Security Audits: Our systems undergo independent security assessments
• Geographic Data Storage: Your data is stored in {{DATA_LOCATION}} with backup redundancy

You maintain full control over your encryption keys, ensuring maximum privacy protection.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
We use collected information solely for the following purposes:

• Service Provision: Storing, syncing, and managing your files across devices
• Account Management: Maintaining your account and processing payments
• Security Monitoring: Detecting unauthorized access and preventing abuse
• Customer Support: Responding to your inquiries and technical issues
• Service Improvement: Analyzing usage patterns to enhance performance (using anonymized data only)

We do not scan, analyze, or monetize your personal files. We do not use your data for advertising purposes or share it with marketing partners.

sections.heading: Data Sharing and Third Parties
sections.content:
{{SERVICE_NAME}} follows strict data sharing principles:

• No Commercial Sharing: We never sell or rent your personal data to third parties
• Service Providers: We may share limited data with trusted partners who help operate our service (hosting, payment processing)
• Legal Compliance: We may disclose information only when required by valid legal process
• User Consent: Any other sharing requires your explicit consent
• Data Processing Agreements: All third-party partners sign strict data protection agreements

We will notify users of government data requests unless legally prohibited, and we regularly publish transparency reports detailing any such requests.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Rights
sections.content:
You have comprehensive rights regarding your personal data:

• Access: Request copies of all personal data we hold about you
• Portability: Export your data in common formats at any time
• Deletion: Permanently delete your account and all associated data
• Correction: Update or correct any inaccurate personal information
• Restriction: Limit how we process your data
• Objection: Object to certain types of data processing

To exercise these rights, contact us at {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}. We will respond within {{RESPONSE_TIME}} business days. You can also download your data directly through your account settings.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
sections.content:
We retain your data according to the following schedule:

• Active Accounts: Data stored as long as your account remains active
• Inactive Accounts: {{INACTIVE_PERIOD}} of inactivity before account review
• Deleted Files: Recoverable from trash for {{TRASH_RETENTION}} days
• Account Deletion: Complete data removal within {{DELETION_TIME}} of request
• Legal Requirements: Some data may be retained longer if required by applicable law

You can delete individual files, folders, or your entire account at any time. We provide secure data deletion that makes recovery impossible.
